slides.text: Your AI agent now works <accent>while you're not watching.</accent> Recurring tasks. Reminders. Monitoring. All inside <accent>one session.</accent> Invoke with /loop or just <accent>plain English.</accent>

slides.heading: How to <accent>Use</accent> It
slides.body:
- Type /loop or natural language
- Set interval (5m, 1h, etc.)
- Loop any skill or command
- Cancel anytime with 'stop'

slides.text: Every 5 minutes, my loop checks the deploy. Every hour, it reviews open PRs. Every morning, it preps my standup. All while I'm doing real work.

slides.heading: <accent>6</accent> Ways to Use Loop
items: Run review-pr skill on a schedule

slides.heading: Know the <accent>Limits</accent>
slides.body:
- 3-day max expiry, then auto-deletes
- Close terminal = all loops gone
- No catch-up if you miss a fire
- Each tab has its own separate loops
- For anything longer, use Scheduled Tasks
